title: DDI-BurdenMap: reproducible mapping of drug-drug interaction burden across candidate and curated networks
description: Reproducibility code, redistributable analytical inputs, aggregate outputs, figures, and manuscript materials for DDI-BurdenMap, a severity- and mechanism-aware network analysis of where drug-drug interaction burden concentrates. DDInter source and processed pair-level files are not redistributed; the included preparation script reconstructs the analytical edge list locally from DDInter public downloads.
